content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On sales invoice:new, clicking Save (597, 599) raises a visible validation error (600:e618), then the user edits the Due Date and Customer inputs (344, 606, 665, 667) and clicks Save again (658, 660), which raises another visible error (662:e688).", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, change the Save button's submit handler so that when it fails validation it focuses and scrolls to the first invalid field (the one named in the visible error) and shows the message beside that field, instead of only showing a generic error banner.", "cited_event_ids": ["597", "599", "600:e618", "344", "606", "665", "667", "658", "660", "662:e688"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The visible error text and the field it names are not in the events, so the field that fails validation is unverified.", "Whether the edits to Due Date and Customer fix the error is not shown; the error could come from a different field.", "The error at 353:a351 appears before any Save click, so its relation to the Save loop is unverified."]}
